bullseye.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
files=[Path('/etc/apt/sources.list')]+list(Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d').glob('*.list'))+list(Path('/etc/apt/sources.list.d').glob('*.sources'))
for p in files:
 if not p.exists():continue
 text=p.read_text()
 if 'deb.debian.org/debian-security' not in text:continue
 text=text.replace('http://deb.debian.org/debian-security','https://archive.debian.org/debian-security').replace('https://deb.debian.org/debian-security','https://archive.debian.org/debian-security')
 if p.suffix=='.sources':
  blocks=[]
  for block in text.split('\n\n'):
   if 'archive.debian.org/debian-security' in block and 'Check-Valid-Until:' not in block:block+='\nCheck-Valid-Until: no'
   blocks.append(block)
  text='\n\n'.join(blocks)
 else:
  lines=[]
  for line in text.splitlines():
   if 'archive.debian.org/debian-security' in line and line.startswith('deb ') and '[' not in line:line=line.replace('deb ','deb [check-valid-until=no] ',1)
   lines.append(line)
  text='\n'.join(lines)+'\n'
 p.write_text(text)
PY
rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
apt-get update
